attributes.name: data-orientation
attributes.description: Tool strip direction; auto resolves to horizontal for inline, vertical otherwise. Re-resolved when changed

attributes.name: data-fab-icon
attributes.description: Icon name for the mobile FAB

attributes.name: data-fab-label
attributes.description: Accessible label for the FAB and its popover panel

attributes.name: data-breakpoint
attributes.description: Viewport width at or below which the toolbar collapses to a FAB

attributes.name: data-resolved-orientation
attributes.description: Reflected effective orientation (data-orientation resolved against data-position)

attributes.name: data-collapsed
attributes.description: Present while the toolbar is collapsed to the FAB (viewport at or below data-breakpoint)

structure.description: Generated FAB (popovertarget → panel); visible only while collapsed. Internal (data-page-tools-internal)
Generated popover panel that holds the tools while collapsed. Internal (data-page-tools-internal)

properties.name: tools
properties.description: The tool elements (author children, excluding the generated FAB and popover; read from the popover while collapsed)

cssProperties.name: --page-tools-offset
cssProperties.description: Sticky top offset / fixed inline-end offset

cssProperties.name: --page-tools-button-padding
cssProperties.description: Padding of normalised icon tool buttons

cssProperties.name: --page-tools-fab-bottom
cssProperties.description: FAB distance from the viewport block-end edge

cssProperties.name: --page-tools-fab-end
cssProperties.description: FAB distance from the viewport inline-end edge
